title: PRICE_ASK misses a storage price asked without is or are after how much, and prices a RAM or data-limit requirement ask
goal: kf_index.PRICE_ASK (the regex kbfacts re-exports) gives the priced note to a storage or data price asked with another verb than is or are ('How much do I pay for storage per user per month?', 'How much does OneDrive storage run per user per month?', 'How much for extra storage per user per month?') and none to a requirement ask worded with is ('How much is RAM required per device?', 'How much is the minimum RAM per device for Windows 11?'), while the price asks it already matches stay matched. Found by the SP-vk3wf746 review (S3).
